sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that setback, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and a +12 goal difference. They face a struggling Alsager side bottom of the division with just 4 points, winless in their last eight matches, making this an ideal opportunity for Sandbach to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, with Stafford coming off their own recent loss and looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth in the table—both sides have won their last matches. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter, then face an immediate return fixture as Brereton Social (currently in the relegation zone) host Wednesfield on Wednesday evening. In-form Bilston Town (five wins in last six) host Foley Meir, while Barnton (four wins in last five) entertain Shawbury United, who are in freefall with six consecutive losses. Telford Town (struggling with one win in ten) travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads in a battle between two of the division's poorest performers, and New Mills host Market Drayton Town in another fixture between teams in mid-to-lower positions. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in the final Saturday fixture, with Allscott having won their last two. Widnes Town, bottom of the league with just 2 points, face an uphill task away at Brereton Social on Saturday.
